sections.title: Three generations *of service*

image.alt: The Beech Island Appliance Service team in company shirts in front of a branded service van

body: Established in 1959, Beech Island Appliance Service is one of the oldest family-owned HVAC and appliance service companies in the CSRA. Since our first service visit over 60 years ago, we’ve been committed to customer satisfaction.

Whether the heat pump, furnace, air conditioner or an appliance at your home or business needs regular maintenance, a time-sensitive repair or replacement, our trained technicians combine timeless craftsmanship with modern technology, and they’re ready to answer your questions along the way.

items.text: The representative presented all of our options with prices. There were no high pressure tactics used to attempt to sell me “more”. The technicians arrived on time. They were very professional and efficient.

They didn’t rush me in any kind of way in making a decision to buy and made sure I understood the unit. They showed me how to work it and program the settings and helped me download the app on my phone.

items.q: Which brands do you work on?
items.a: We service all HVAC brands. For new systems we install Trane comfort systems exclusively, with a free on-site estimate.
All brands of major appliances: refrigerators, dishwashers, ovens, ranges, cooktops, washers and dryers, with in-home service.

items.q: Can I finance a new system?
items.a: Yes, with approved credit, including the Wells Fargo Home Projects credit card. Call us for details.
